# HealthKit spec: identifier and enumeration appendix

Part of `specs/frameworks/healthkit/`. Every table row is an interop fact: a public
symbol name, the string value or raw number it has at run time, and the iOS version
that introduced it. Columns marked (L3) were measured by `HealthProbe` on the iOS
27.1 and 27.0 simulator runtimes (identical results); "iOS" is the introduction
version from SDK availability metadata (L4). No declarations or documentation text
are reproduced.

Conventions: "agg" is the quantity type's aggregation style (L3, raw value in
brackets); "dimension" is the unit family the type accepts, found by testing
compatibility against a fixed list of base units (L3); "max" is the maximum
allowed sample duration in seconds when the type restricts it (L3; 345600 s = 4
days); "per-object" means the type uses per-object read authorization (L3).
